items.title: Google Cloud adds OpenAI models to Model Garden
problems: The item dates the announcement to 21 October, but the readable Google Cloud source does not state an announcement date.
The before field says teams managed OpenAI inference separately from Google's catalog, billing, and controls, but the source does not describe that prior arrangement.

items.title: IBM updates Granite Speech models for multilingual, on-device transcription
problems: The item says IBM released Granite Speech 5.0 2B on 21 October, but its model card gives the release date as 20 October; the blog announcement was published on 21 October.
The after field says both the 2B and 470M variants run through common runtimes, but these sources document runtime support only for the 2B model.
